subject: FinTechCorp - security discovery follow-up: SOC2, IR timelines & BCP evidence
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <m.patel@fintechcorp.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T15:02:00Z
Subject: Follow-up: Security discovery + IR/BCP evidence (SOC2 / vendor questionnaire)

Hi Alex & Maya,

Thanks for the time on today's call — appreciate the detailed questions from your security and infra teams. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep procurement moving: 

Recap:
- Scope: Redwood inference platform (hosted API + optional Private deployment for data residency).
- Key controls asked: SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA applicability, incident response + breach notification timelines, BCP/DR evidence.

Action items / next steps:
1) I'll share our SOC 2 summary and a short extract of our IR playbook for your reviewers (see attachments).
2) You mentioned a vendor security questionnaire — happy to start that process. If you can send the spreadsheet or OneTrust link we will assign SE + security SME to complete within 5 business days.
3) Please confirm your required breach notification SLA (you mentioned 72 hours as a target). We will confirm Redwood's contractual notification clause and propose language if needed.
4) If you want evidence for BCP/DR (RTO/RPO, runbook excerpts, table-top exercise summaries), please confirm which artifacts matter most and we will pull what we can share.

I've looped in Marissa (solutions engineering) and Laura (security) to help provide the questionnaire responses and IR/BCP artifacts.

Attachments: SOC2_summary_2025.pdf, IR_playbook_excerpt.docx

Would love to sync on Monday for a 30-min follow-up to walk the team through the attachments and confirm any redlines. Are you available Monday 6/3 10-10:30am PT?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(j) 415-555-0132 | jordan.blake@redwood.com


From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechcorp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <m.patel@fintechcorp.com>, security@fintechcorp.com
Date: 2026-06-01T17:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Security discovery + IR/BCP evidence (SOC2 / vendor questionnaire)

Hi Jordan — thanks for the concise recap and for sending the attachments. Quick answers from our side: 

- SOC 2: We need the latest SOC 2 Type II report or a SOC 2 summary with auditor and period details. The summary you attached is good for initial review; we'll request the full report later in procurement (NDAs are fine).
- Vendor questionnaire: attaching the vendor security questionnaire spreadsheet (we typically use OneTrust, but I also send an xlsx for teams that prefer email). Please have your security SME complete tabs A-C.
- Breach notification: our legal team requires notification within 72 hours of confirmation of a breach affecting our customer data. Can you confirm Redwood's contractual position? We may need a short clause for the SOW.
- BCP/DR: Useful artifacts are RTO/RPO statements for production APIs, recent table-top exercise summary, and any third-party continuity attestations. If some details are sensitive, redacted excerpts are fine.

Availability: Monday 6/3 10:00am PT works for us; send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Head of Security Engineering | FinTechCorp
alex.johnson@fintechcorp.com

Attachment: FinTechCorp_Vendor_Sec_Questionnaire.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T19:05:00Z
Subject: RE: Follow-up: Security discovery + IR/BCP evidence (SOC2 / vendor questionnaire)

Thanks Jordan — taking this on. Plan:
- I'll own the vendor questionnaire (FinTech spreadsheet) and coordinate with Laura for any high-sensitivity answers.
- Laura: can you confirm whether we can share the full SOC 2 Type II under NDA? If so, I'll flag that to Alex and provide the SOC 2 contact and timeframe.
- For IR/BCP artifacts, I can pull RTO/RPO for hosted API, and a redacted table-top exercise summary. We should avoid sharing internal runbooks; instead we can provide excerpts and attestations.

Calendar: I'll create the Monday 6/3 10am PT invite and include the SE demo link.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechcorp.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T01:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Security discovery + IR/BCP evidence (SOC2 / vendor questionnaire)

Alex — Laura here from Redwood Security. Quick answers on the SOC2 and breach notification: 

- SOC 2 Type II: We can share the full SOC 2 Type II under NDA. The report period is 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 and auditor is NorthStar Assurance. For initial review, the SOC2_summary_2025.pdf covers control scope, key exceptions (none), and management responses.
- Breach notification: Redwood's standard security addendum commits to notifying customers within 72 hours of confirming a security incident that impacts customer data. If you need specific contractual language, we can propose a clause matching your legal team's template.
- IR timelines: Our internal SLA for triage and customer notification is: detection within 24 hours, investigation within 48 hours, customer notification within 72 hours from confirmation. Root cause and remediation timelines vary by incident severity; we can provide a timeline template for the SOW.
- BCP/DR: We can provide RTO (30 minutes for critical auth endpoints; 4 hours for bulk batch jobs) and RPO (15 minutes for streaming KV caches; 1 hour for async jobs) statements for the hosted offering. We'll prepare a redacted tabletop summary.

I'll upload the SOC2 under NDA or send via secure ShareFile link if you prefer. Let me know your preference and any required recipients for the NDA.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Information Security | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechcorp.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <m.patel@fintechcorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, security@fintechcorp.com
Date: 2026-06-03T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Security discovery + IR/BCP evidence (SOC2 / vendor questionnaire)

Thanks Laura — that lines up with what we need.

Next steps on our side:
- I'll send a standard mutual NDA and a brief request for the SOC 2 report recipients (legal + security).
- We'll expect the completed vendor questionnaire within 5 business days after you confirm and upload answers.
- Please upload IR/BCP artifacts to the secure Drive folder listed below or send via ShareFile link. If possible, include RTO/RPO as statements in the questionnaire workbook.

Drive (secure folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/fintech-sec-evidence-2026
NDA: Pending (will send by EOD).

See you on Monday 6/3 10:00am PT — invite accepted.

Alex
